en.title: Ryan Reynolds Celebrates 'The Odyssey' Overtaking 'Deadpool & Wolverine' for R-Rated Crown
en.summary: Ryan Reynolds has tipped his hat to the massive success of 'The Odyssey,' congratulating the film for surpassing his own 'Deadpool & Wolverine' to become the highest-grossing R-rated movie of all time. This moment marks a significant win for R-rated cinema in a booming box office year.
en.body:
Hollywood is experiencing a golden era for R-rated films, and **Ryan Reynolds** is leading the cheers. The star behind the irreverent **Deadpool** franchise recently took to social media to congratulate the cast and crew of **‘The Odyssey’** on a monumental achievement: becoming the highest-grossing R-rated movie of all time. In doing so, **‘The Odyssey’** has officially surpassed **‘Deadpool & Wolverine’**, a film **Reynolds** himself helped bring to the screen.

This passing of the torch is a significant moment, underscoring the commercial viability and audience appetite for mature-themed blockbusters. **Reynolds**, known for his sharp wit both on and off-screen, didn't hold back his admiration. His congratulatory message, shared widely, acknowledged the immense effort and success of **‘The Odyssey’**. While the specifics of the film’s plot remain a topic of discussion among fans, its box office dominance speaks volumes about its widespread appeal. The summer has been particularly strong, with other major releases also drawing large crowds, creating what **Reynolds** described as "the friggin’ salad days" for the industry.

## A New R-Rated King is Crowned

The box office landscape has shifted, with **‘The Odyssey’** now holding the coveted title of the highest-grossing R-rated film ever. This achievement is a testament to the film's broad appeal and the successful marketing strategies that resonated with audiences worldwide. **Ryan Reynolds**, a key figure in the R-rated comedy-action genre, recognized the magnitude of this accomplishment. His public endorsement not only celebrates **‘The Odyssey’** but also highlights the collaborative spirit within the film community, even amidst competitive box office battles. The source material indicates that **Reynolds** specifically shared clips showing **Deadpool** and **Wolverine** in a memorable scene inside a Honda Odyssey minivan, adding a touch of meta-humor to his congratulations.

> "Congratulations to the entire cast and crew of **The Odyssey** for becoming the highest grossing R-rated movie of all time. That is one helluva car."

## Fan Frenzy and Future Implications

For fans, this news is more than just a box office record; it's a validation of the power of bold storytelling and genre filmmaking. The success of **‘The Odyssey’** alongside other R-rated hits suggests a growing audience eager for content that doesn't shy away from adult themes and complex narratives. This could pave the way for more studios to invest in similar projects, expanding the diversity of blockbuster offerings. The shared excitement across fan communities online reflects a collective appreciation for this new cinematic milestone. It’s a moment that sparks conversations about what makes an R-rated film a massive success and how different audiences connect with these stories.

## What's Next

As **‘The Odyssey’** continues its reign, attention will undoubtedly turn to its long-term box office performance and potential future installments. The success of **‘Deadpool & Wolverine’** and **‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day’** also points towards a robust future for big-budget, genre-defining films. Further details regarding **‘The Odyssey’**’s legacy and any potential follow-ups have not yet been announced.
